sections.title: 3. Prices and Payment
items: 3.1. The prices stated for the respective services as determined by the relevant Premier Studio Freelancer shall apply at the time the order is placed ("Service Fees").
3.2. You are required to pay a handling fee of 10% for commissions up to and including $1,000 USD, and 6% for commissions above $1,000 USD ("Handling Fee").
3.3. All prices are exclusive of Taxes, and you shall be responsible for all Taxes applicable under this Agreement.
3.4. We will invoice you for Service and Handling Fees due in accordance with the provisions of the requested Services.

3.5. Before your Premier Studio Freelancer begins providing the Services, you will be required to pay: 
• i) a 50% deposit of the Service and Handling Fees for normal work 
• ii) a 100% deposit of the Service and Handling Fees for live work
Normal work: Done on the freelancer's machine with watermarked output after 50% deposit.
Live work: Done on the client's infrastructure with full client access.
3.6. All payments must be made in cleared funds, through nominated payment methods, without set-off, withholding, or deduction.

sections.title: 4. Refunds
items:
4.1. Refunds are only provided at our sole discretion and are not guaranteed.
4.2. If you are eligible for a refund, it will be processed using the original payment method.
4.3. No refunds will be provided for completed work or for deposits on live work after work has commenced.

sections.title: 5. Out-of-Scope Assignments
items: 5.1. Additional work or altered scope is treated as Out-of-Scope Assignments.
5.2. Acceptance of such assignments requires a new written agreement. Examples include:

• Change of mind
  • Midway product change
  • Add-ons to a project
5.3. Refusal to pay for Out-of-Scope Assignments will result in delivery of the project as per original scope, without refund.

sections.title: 6. Chargeback
items: You agree to contact us first before initiating any chargeback or dispute. Fraudulent chargebacks will result in:

• Blacklisting
  • Legal action
  • Reselling the work to recover loss

sections.title: 7. Cancellation
items: 7.1. We may cancel Services at any time before delivery.
7.2. Except when required by law, we are not liable for any cancellation-related loss.

sections.title: 8. Commissions
items: 8.1. A commission is complete once delivered and accepted.
8.2. It will auto-complete after 14 days without client response.
8.3. A hold can be placed for up to 1 month (with possible extension).
8.4. No refund if you cancel after work begins.
8.5. Changing freelancers resets your commission and cancels previous agreements.

sections.title: 9. 30 Days Support
items: 9.1. Support is offered for 30 days post-completion.
9.2. Subject to fair use and scope of work.
9.3. No support will be provided:

• Beyond 30 days
  • If the service was altered by third parties
  • If misused or instructions were ignored
9.4. Additional support beyond 30 days is chargeable.

items: You grant us a royalty-free, irrevocable, perpetual license to showcase completed work (excluding your name/brand unless it’s part of the scope) for promotional or portfolio use.

sections.title: 12. Reporting Violations
items: Report violations via Discord tickets or DMs. Misuse of the reporting system may result in account suspension. We are not responsible for any payments made directly to freelancers.

items: Unless agreed otherwise, you must not:

Violations may result in blacklisting and legal action.

sections.title: 14. Confidentiality
items: We agree to maintain confidentiality. If you require an NDA, notify us early.

sections.title: 15. Project Files
items: We archive project files, but you are responsible for keeping your own backups. We are not liable for data loss.
